newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-WEST INDIES TO BAT AFTER WINNING THE TOSS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-WEST INDIES TO BAT AFTER WINNING THE TOSS.

text.p: West Indies captain Courtney Walsh elected to bat after winning the toss in the World Series limited overs match at the Sydney Cricket Ground on Sunday.
West Indies batsman Shivnarine Chanderpaul failed a fitness test on a groin injury and was replaced by Roland Holder.
Opener Robert Samuels lost his place to Adrian Griffifth in a further change from the side that lost the opening fixture against Australia by five wickets on Friday.
Australia recalled fast bowler Glenn McGrath, who was rested in Melbourne, at the expense of fellow paceman Jason Gillespie.
Australia - Mark Taylor (captain), Mark Waugh, Ricky Ponting, Greg Blewett, Michael Bevan, Stuart Law, Tom Moody, Ian Healy, Paul Reiffel, Shane Warne, Glenn McGrath, Jason Gillespie 12th man.

West Indies - Sherwin Campbell, Adrian Griffith, Brian Lara, Carl Hooper, Jimmy Adams, Roland Holder, Junior Murray, Nixon McLean, Kenneth Benjamin, Curtly Ambrose, Courtney Walsh (captain), Robert Samuels, 12th man.
